commands.note: The runner verifies the recorded packet and supplied artifacts, then writes fresh evidence to a new directory. It never overwrites an existing run. Offline verification is not cryptographic proof of execution; the rerun is the execution check.
commands.prerequisite: Fresh local replay needs a shell that permits local TCP listeners on 127.0.0.1 and 0.0.0.0. run-case.cjs now fails fast with a setup error if the shell denies the bind; increasing Node heap will not fix it.
